title: Repair rotation within a normalized list slice
goal: Implement rotate_slice(items, start, stop, steps) for a list of integers and integer start/stop/steps. Return a new list equal to items except that the subsequence selected by ordinary Python unit-step slicing items[start:stop] is rotated to the right by steps positions. Negative steps rotate left, and the rotation wraps modulo the length of the selected subsequence. Normalize negative and out-of-range start/stop exactly as Python slicing does; if the normalized selection is empty, including when stop is before start, return an unchanged copy. Values outside the selected slice stay in their original positions. Preserve duplicates. Empty input returns []. Do not mutate items.
constraints: Only edit solution.py; do not add files or dependencies or modify tests.
Keep the public function rotate_slice(items, start, stop, steps) and its signature unchanged.

provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct authored inputs and bounded independent checks of the same stated specification
